name: string-value-xml-test-f2ac2e01f3/string-value-xml-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements — lists supported statements, including Local variable declarations, but does not list XML namespace declarations.
## Module-level declarations — does not list XML namespace declarations.
## Expressions — XML template expression: 'Supports interpolation in XML content and attributes'; 'XML sequence interpolation from a query result is not supported'.
## Import declarations — ballerina/lang.value includes `toString`; ballerina/lang.string includes `length`; ballerina/lang.xml includes `length` and `fromString`.
### Other invocation restrictions — permits `string:length`, `value:toString` and `xml:length` method syntax.
reason: The namespace tests require local xmlns declarations (both default and prefixed), a declaration/statement construct not covered by the supported lists. This suffices to classify the whole mixed case as feature. The remaining XML templates, Unicode string lengths, serialization via value:toString, XML parsing via xml:fromString and XML length use listed facilities. The xml-qualified-names restriction concerns variable references and does not by itself exclude prefixed XML template tags/attributes.
unsupported_constructs: Local XML namespace declarations: xmlns "http://ballerina.com/"; and xmlns "http://ballerina.com/💯aa" as ns0;
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: main asserts ordinary comment, element, text, processing-instruction, parsing and interpolation behavior alongside namespace declaration cases.
The @output markers assert exact Unicode-aware serialized string lengths and xml:fromString result length; they are behavioral assertions, not just signature checks. No obvious marker-format issue.
